name: zumpo
description: Little browser games, on your own or in real-time rooms.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names server,client --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm run design:tokens -- --check && npm run audio:check && npm test && npm run build
scripts.e2e: npm run build && playwright test -c e2e
scripts.design:compare: npm run build && playwright test -c e2e/screens.config.ts
